CheckTitle: Ensure access keys unused for 45 days or more are disabled
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices/Identity and Access Management
Description: Checks for active IAM access keys that have not been used in 45 days or more.
Risk: Dormant but active keys are attractive, unmonitored attack paths that nobody will notice being abused.

Recommendation.Text: Deactivate or delete access keys that have not been used for 45 days.
